To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel weakly supervised object localization approach that uses a decoupled object representation to improve object-background distinction.

(1) we propose a novel object representation model which decouples object representation to image representation and attention map regression; (2) we propose a new attention localization module which can effectively suppress the irrelevant backgrounds and occlusions inside object bounding box; (3) we demonstrate that the proposed object representation module can be seamlessly integrated with a weakly supervised object detector and can effectively improve detection performance; and (4) we conduct comprehensive experiments on the PASCal VOC 2007/2012 datasets,
we present a weakly supervised object detector that uses attention to suppress the background.
In summary, our research is concerned with
weakly supervised object localization, which is a fundamental problem in computer vision and has many applications in various domains.

a well designed deep representation is essential to improve the performance of weakly supervised object detectors.
